name: reasoning-discipline-verified
description: a REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT with no opener is a streaming-discipline violation and is rejected, exactly as the same shape is for a text message: reasoning messages and spans are bracketed like every other streamed entity, and the consumer does not invent the message an orphaned fragment names
kill: stop reading the reasoning open/close sets in verifyEvents — delete the `if (!open.has(messageId))` guard in verify.ts's REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT / REASONING_MESSAGE_END / REASONING_END branch, where `open` is the per-branch alias for `activeReasoningMessages` (`activeReasoningSpans` when the event is REASONING_END), and the orphaned fragment is tolerated again

expect.errorContains: No active reasoning message found with ID 'm-reasoning-discipline-1'

dotnet.intentional: The .NET client has no reasoning open/close verification: REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT yields a reasoning-content update whether or not an opener preceded it, so the stream is accepted and an extra message survives. `errorContains` is deliberately the empty string, which asserts nothing — it LIFTS the base's requirement rather than restating it, because this lane produces no rejection to match against; the outcome and message assertions below are what it is actually held to. Microsoft.Extensions.AI carries reasoning as TextReasoningContent, which AsAGUIMessages does not project into `content`. Closing this divergence means giving the .NET client the same bracketing check and deleting this override.
